summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 of the cipher-box project, which covers E2E test expansion (account cleanup helpers, media/streaming tests, batch download tests) and staging environment baselines (journey timing, load tests, BYO-IPFS/Pinata integration).
summary.outcome: All 4 plans completed and phase verified (13/13 must-haves). New E2E test suites (streaming-playback, media-preview, batch-download) committed, deleteAccountViaPage helper wired into all 10 specs, staging journey timing baselines captured, and BYO load test plan activated with Pinata. SDK load tests were throttle-limited but produced useful baseline data.

repo: Playwright config does not respect BASE_URL env var by default — baseURL must explicitly read process.env.BASE_URL and webServer must be conditionally omitted when targeting staging.
Web3Auth SDK initialization on staging takes >20s, causing tests with 20s timeouts to fail; staging needs a longer timeout (45s+) for wallet button initialization.
The deleteAccountViaPage cleanup helper hardcodes localhost:3000 for the API URL; on staging it must derive the API base from the current page URL (replace app subdomain with api subdomain).
Vitest does not automatically load .env files — dotenv or shell-level env sourcing is required for test environment variables.
The SDK load test harness does not forward THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET during createTestAccount, so staging rate-limits bulk account creation to ~10/200 clients before blocking with 429s.
Worktree-based parallel executor agents each commit to their own branch; cherry-picking to the phase branch causes STATE.md merge conflicts that must be resolved manually.

code.finding: Added BASE_URL env var support and conditional webServer skip when targeting non-local environments.
waitFor timeout increased from 20s to 45s for wallet-login-button to accommodate Web3Auth cold-start on staging.
Fixed API URL derivation to use page URL (replace app. with api.) rather than hardcoded localhost:3000.
Vitest does not load .env automatically; env vars must be sourced in shell before running tests.
Plan was initially committed with DEFERRED status; updated to ACTIVE once Pinata credentials were available.

workflow: GSD parallel executor agents use --no-verify on commits to avoid pre-commit hook contention; orchestrator validates hooks once after wave completes.
When Task() agents complete in worktrees, their commits must be cherry-picked to the phase branch — STATE.md always conflicts and must be taken from the worktree version.
Staging load tests should be run sequentially, not in parallel, to avoid competing for the same throttle budget on the same staging instance.
Browser-based Playwright load tests timeout at 10m when simulating 5 concurrent full-browser clients; they produce useful throughput/error-rate data even when incomplete.
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code runtime bug can cause agents to report 'failed' even after successful completion — spot-check via SUMMARY.md existence and git commits.

friction: BASE_URL env var not respected by Playwright config — tests silently hit localhost instead of staging, causing misleading timeout failures.
Web3Auth 20s init timeout caused initial journey-timing test failure on staging; required code change to unblock.
Git lock contention when 34-03 agent tried to operate after 34-02 — required manual worktree cleanup and agent retry.
Cherry-picking parallel worktree commits to phase branch consistently produces STATE.md merge conflicts requiring manual resolution.
Vitest does not auto-load .env files; BYO tests silently skipped with 'env not set' rather than failing with a clear error.
SDK load test harness does not pass THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET during account creation, causing staging to 429-block 190/200 test accounts.
BYO capacity ceiling test and sustained load test competed on the same staging instance, contaminating both result sets.
open_items: SDK load test harness (createTestAccount) needs to forward THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET so bulk account creation is not rate-limited on staging.
BYO capacity ceiling test (50→100→200→500→1000 clients) was never successfully completed due to throttle blocking — needs a re-run once harness fix is in place.
Sustained load baseline at 200 clients is not representative (only 10 clients actually ran) — needs re-run after throttle bypass fix.
Faro/Grafana trace verification (Step 3 of staging baselines) was not completed — requires visual inspection of Grafana dashboard.
Prometheus metrics check (curl metrics endpoint, grep ipfs_operation_duration) was not recorded in baselines.
The browser-based 5-client load test timed out at 10m with partial results (305/395 ops) — a longer timeout or fewer ops per client would give cleaner data.
deleteAccountViaPage cleanup helper logs '401 at refresh' errors during staging runs for accounts that were already cleaned up or expired — may need idempotency check.
